text:
Maya - CSM: Heads-up: Valence onboarding. They're hitting lots of short interactive calls (median ~18 tokens) and occasional report-generation jobs (seq ~220). Renewal in 5 weeks — want options to cut cost without risking numeric accuracy.

Arjun - ML Eng: Pattern suggests split-by-workload. Proposal: route <=48 tokens to an int8 compact for latency/cost wins; route >48 to fp16 standard or dedicated pool. Run a 500-sample numeric-equality check vs baseline.

Sofia - SuccessOps: Recommend a conservative pilot: 3% canary on short-path, prefix cache for repeated confirmations, and watchlist of critical prompts. Acceptance: >=12% cost reduction OR p95 <= 300ms AND numeric-diff <=0.8%.

Kai - SRE: Safety guards: only run the canary 09:00-17:00 local Mon-Fri initially. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or numeric-diff > 1%. Alert on p95 increase >15%.

Arjun - ML Eng: Suggested config (dry-run):

```
route_rules:
  - name: valence-short-canary
    match: "request.tokens <= 48 && rand() < 0.03"
    target_model: gpt-compact-int8-v1
    fallback: gpt-compact-fp16-v1
    metrics: [p95, error_rate, numeric_diff]
  - name: valence-long-path
    match: "request.tokens > 48"
    target_model: gpt-standard-fp16-v2
slo_guards:
  error_rate_threshold_pct: 0.5
  numeric_diff_threshold_pct: 1.0
  p95_increase_pct: 15
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  ttl_seconds: 180
monitoring:
  sample_size: 500
  lookback: 1h
```
Arjun - ML Eng: I'll run the 500-sample regression tonight and post embedding-similarity + numeric-equality numbers by tomorrow morning.

Sofia - SuccessOps: I'll draft the one-pager for Valence SREs with rollback steps and a short FAQ. Also coordinate a 30m sync for Thursday.

Maya - CSM: I'll pitch this as a "renewal optimization trial" — if thresholds met, include a 3-month cost credit.

pilot-bot: canary workspace created: /canaries/3623456789-preview. Dry-run logs: /deploys/3623456789/preview

Kai - SRE: If Arjun's numbers look good, we can increase to 12% during off-peak for 8 hours to gather stronger signal. Keep alerts tight.

Maya - CSM: Great work. Action items: Arjun -> regression + perf numbers; Sofia -> one-pager + sync; Kai -> alerting + dry-run; Maya -> customer coordination. Will update thread after regression. :white_check_mark:
